T-002.plain: Summarise who answered the survey, variable by variable.

T-003.label: Approve the models
T-003.plain: You confirm the models match what was promised in the pre-registration.

T-004.label: Set exclusion rule
T-004.plain: You decide whether inattentive respondents stay in the sample.

T-005.label: Estimate main models
T-005.plain: Run the three pre-registered models and record the estimates.

T-006.label: Chart trust by arm
T-006.plain: Draw average trust for each group, split by survey wave.

T-007.label: Draft the paper
T-007.plain: Write the working paper around the tables and figures.

T-008.label: Draft the slides
T-008.plain: Build a short talk that presents the main result.

T-009.label: Package for replication
T-009.plain: Bundle code and data so anyone can rebuild every output.
